tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Look up one Larkspur order by its order number. Returns the customer, items, total, status, refunds and any note the customer left.

tools.name: list_orders_for_customer
tools.title: List a customer's orders
tools.description: List every Larkspur order placed by one customer, newest first.

customer.description: The customer's company name, for example Hollis Hardware.

tools.name: issue_refund
tools.title: Issue refund
tools.description: Refund money on one Larkspur order to the customer's original payment method. This moves real money.

amount.description: Amount to refund in US dollars.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.title: Get calendar
tools.description: List the Larkspur team's calendar events on one date.

prompts.name: refund_request
prompts.title: Refund request
prompts.description: Ask the assistant to check an order against the refund policy and refund it if the policy allows.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Why the customer wants their money back.

prompts.template: A customer wants a refund for order {order_id} because: {reason}. Look up the order, check it against the Larkspur refund policy, and issue the refund only if the policy allows it.
